title: feat(nstrin): three-site formdraw n(C)!=n(D): reverse UNDEFINED, face UNDEFINED
science: Three-site seed x-probes, strictly-earlier kernel. Records the saturation mechanism: D=(1,1,0) has all six neighbours recorded, so n(D)=(0,0,0) identically and no sign letter exists. Shows the occupancy-kernel readout is self-extinguishing — it is defined only during a transient and vanishes at any probe deep inside the recorded region.
